dienstplan.title: Dienstplan - Polizei
dienstplan.subtitle: The modern solution for your shift planning
dienstplan.description: Keep track of your shifts and your partner's. Add holidays to better plan appointments.

features.partnerShifts: Display your partner's shifts and see at a glance when you have time together.
features.holidays: Display holidays and public holidays from a selected German state and identify conflicts with your shifts early.
features.colorCustomization: Customize colors for holidays, your shift plan, and your partner's to better understand everything at a glance.
features.availablePlans: Choose from pre-made shift plans for various areas of Polizei Bremen and OPB Bremerhaven, such as police stations, riot police units, and shift schedules.

grounds.title: Grounds Network
grounds.subtitle: Building the foundation for the next generation of Minecraft multiplayer experiences
grounds.description: A connected platform for creators, developers, and players. Our mission is to make high-quality game infrastructure, tools, and worlds accessible to everyone.

features.feature1: Practice and improve your skills with dedicated training modes
features.feature2: Modern software stack and infrastructure for competitive gameplay
features.feature3: Customizable user interfaces and cosmetic items for enhanced player experience
features.feature4: Build and publish your own custom game modes and experiences
